structured_output.content: The release note (ev-8ec1fdd0d15f) is filed under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". It only says the internal `third_party/forked/acme` package was patched to support the ACME profiles extension. It does not say whether this changes behaviour or needs any configuration. The environment shows cert-manager v1.17.0 and the cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate kind, but its manifest apiVersions don't include any Issuer or ClusterIssuer, the CRD dimension is absent, and none of the values keys mention ACME, so whether this cluster uses ACME issuers can't be told. If it matters to you, check whether your Issuers or ClusterIssuers use ACME and read PR #7776 to see if any behaviour changed.
